frames = []
for page in (1, 2, 3):
    p = {"_page": page, "_limit": 10}
    r = requests.get(url, params=p,
                     timeout=10)
    r.raise_for_status()
    frames.append(pd.DataFrame(r.json()))
posts = pd.concat(frames,
                  ignore_index=True)
caption: 3 pages of 10 gave a 30-row DataFrame.
